fraction.label: fraction
fraction.prompt: Which fraction should I simplify? Write it as 6/8.

cards:
checkPalindrome — Check whether a word or phrase reads the same backwards.
  needs: text: string
  optional: strict: boolean
  e.g. "is racecar a palindrome" → {"text":"racecar"}

first.label: first word or phrase
first.prompt: What is the first word or phrase?

strict.label: count every character
strict.description: count spaces, punctuation and capitals as part of the text

fromBase.label: from base
fromBase.prompt: What base is it in? (2 for binary, 16 for hex)

toBase.label: to base
toBase.prompt: Which base should I convert to?

value.label: number or numeral
value.prompt: Which number or numeral? (e.g. 2026 or MMXXVI)

from.label: from currency
from.prompt: Which currency is it in? (a three-letter code)

to.label: to currency
to.prompt: Which currency should I convert to?

rate.label: rate per 1 unit
rate.prompt: What exchange rate should I use? (how many of the target currency per 1 of the source)

cards:
durationToText — Turn a raw number of seconds into readable words like "1h 30m".
  needs: seconds: number
  optional: style: string, maxUnits: integer
  e.g. "what is 5400 seconds as a duration" → {"seconds":5400}

countOccurrences — Count how many times one word or phrase repeats inside a text.
  needs: text: string, needle: string
  optional: caseSensitive: boolean, wholeWord: boolean
  e.g. "how many times does "the" appear in this" → {"text":"the cat sat on the mat","needle":"the"}

joinLines — Join the lines of a text into one line, separated by a delimiter you choose.
  needs: text: string
  optional: delimiter: string, skipBlank: boolean, trim: boolean
  e.g. "join these lines with commas" → {"text":"apple\nbanana\ncherry"}

removeDuplicateLines — Remove repeated lines from a text, keeping the first time each one appeared.
  needs: text: string
  optional: ignoreCase: boolean, ignoreSpacing: boolean
  e.g. "remove the duplicate lines" → {"text":"apple\nbanana\napple\ncherry"}

ignoreSpacing.label: ignore spacing
ignoreSpacing.description: treat lines differing only in spacing as the same

findLongestWord — Find the longest word in a text — the biggest word, and any that tie with it.
  needs: text: string
  optional: top: integer
  e.g. "what is the longest word in this sentence" → {"text":"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"}

wordFrequency — Which words repeat most in a text — each distinct word ranked by how often it recurs.
  needs: text: string
  optional: limit: integer, removeStopWords: boolean
  e.g. "what words come up most in this text" → {"text":"the cat sat on the mat the cat purred","limit":2}

cards:
formatCurrency — Write an amount of money the way a currency is normally written, with its symbol and decimal places.
  needs: amount: number, currency: string
  optional: style: string
  e.g. "write 1234.5 as pounds" → {"amount":1234.5,"currency":"GBP"}

currency.label: currency
currency.prompt: Which currency? (a three-letter code like GBP)

query.prompt: Which character, code point or name should I look up?

cards:
darkenColor — Shade a colour towards black by a percentage.
  needs: color: string
  optional: by: number
  e.g. "darken #2C6E8C by 20%" → {"color":"#2C6E8C","by":20}

lightenColor — Tint a colour towards white by a percentage.
  needs: color: string
  optional: by: number
  e.g. "lighten #2C6E8C by 20%" → {"color":"#2C6E8C","by":20}

generateCalendarGrid — Draw a month out as a printable calendar grid of weeks.
  needs: year: integer, month: integer
  optional: startOn: string
  e.g. "show me a calendar grid for September 2026" → {"year":2026,"month":9}

month.label: month
month.prompt: Which month, as a number from 1 to 12?

cards:
dedupeList — Remove repeated items from a list, keeping the first of each and the original order.
  needs: items: array
  optional: ignoreCase: boolean
  e.g. "remove the duplicates from this list" → {"items":["apple","banana","apple","cherry"]}

seed.label: repeatable seed
seed.prompt: Which seed? Any whole number — the same seed always gives the same order.
